US and Iran Engage in Escalating Tensions Over Energy Exports

The United States has launched fresh strikes on Iran, escalating tensions over energy exports in the region. The US claims these actions are necessary to protect its interests, while Iran threatens to halt West Asia energy exports if its demands are not met. The situation has sparked concerns about the potential for conflict and disruptions to global energy supplies.
